milestones.title: Parity M0 - Baseline and architecture
milestones.goal: Define testable contracts, compatible settings, native-backend decisions, and reproducible quality baselines.

milestones.title: Parity M1 - Text and layout
milestones.goal: Deliver paragraph, typography, pagination, multi-column, lazy, geometry, and layout API parity.

milestones.title: Parity M2 - Images and graphics
milestones.goal: Deliver SVG input, image optimization/output controls, and modern container/line styling.

milestones.title: Parity M3 - PDF document operations
milestones.goal: Deliver generated-document merging and existing-PDF processing, security, attachments, and optimization.

milestones.title: Parity M4 - Accessibility and conformance
milestones.goal: Deliver tagged PDF, the six PDF/A-2/PDF/A-3 conformance levels, PDF/UA-1, and validated e-invoice packaging.

milestones.title: Parity M5 - Tooling, deployment and release
milestones.goal: Deliver inspection tooling, qualify NativeAOT/platform support, and publish the final evidence-based parity audit.

work_items.title: Define the parity specification and acceptance fixtures
work_items.summary: Turn the pinned QuestPDF capabilities into a traceable, executable specification and shared fixture corpus.
acceptance: Map every in-scope gap to a work item, public contract, and observable result; classify existing equivalents and unverified capabilities explicitly.
Create independently authored fixtures for pagination, styled text, images, PDF operations, accessibility, and failure cases, with expected semantic results.
Define visual tolerances and API-equivalence rules; demonstrate the fixture runner on the current FossPDF baseline.
validation: Publish fixture IDs and expected outcomes in the repository.
Show existing tests and baseline fixtures passing on .NET 8 and .NET 9.

work_items.title: Choose native backends and dependency contracts
work_items.summary: Assess how supported SkiaSharp, SVG parsing, PDF processing, and tagged-PDF capabilities can cover the target without duplicating native infrastructure.
acceptance: Publish an architecture decision with prototypes for SVG input, existing-PDF operations, and semantic tagging; identify which capabilities the current native stack exposes.
Record dependency versions/licenses/notices, supported runtime assets, native packaging, upgrade policy, and ownership/error-handling contracts.
Select implementation paths and document fallback decisions for unsupported platforms, with an integration contract contributors can build against.
validation: Run proof-of-concept fixtures on Windows, Linux, and macOS for proposed backends.
Verify deterministic cleanup, caller-owned stream handling, and redistributable native assets.

work_items.title: Establish cross-platform visual, conformance and performance baselines
work_items.summary: Make quality evidence reproducible before parallel feature work changes layout or native dependencies.
acceptance: Add reproducible visual/semantic regression infrastructure with pinned fonts and documented platform-specific rendering tolerances.
Record generation time, throughput, allocated bytes, and peak managed/native memory for representative reports, image-heavy documents, large tables, and concurrent generation.
Define reviewable regression budgets from measurements and publish CI artifacts; include warning-free builds and version-pinned external validation tooling.
validation: Exercise Windows, Linux, and macOS CI; distinguish infrastructure failures from rendering failures.
Preserve baseline evidence from FossPDF commit 0339255; add optional QuestPDF reference runs where its licensing terms permit.

work_items.title: Define per-document settings and compatibility rules
work_items.summary: Provide extensible per-document and image-output settings while preserving the existing FossPDF APIs and .NET 9 consumer workflow.
acceptance: Design DocumentSettings/ImageGenerationSettings equivalents covering conformance, compression, image quality/DPI/format, and content direction, with explicit defaults.
Keep existing DocumentMetadata properties, fluent calls, namespaces, .NET 9 support, and netstandard2.1 core consumption working through documented compatibility mappings.
Document which new APIs are available on each target framework and define disposal/stream-ownership contracts for public APIs.
validation: Compile existing samples and a .NET 9 consumer unchanged.
Add tests proving per-document settings do not leak between concurrently generated documents.

work_items.title: Add paragraph justification, logical alignment, indentation and word spacing
work_items.summary: Extend the text layout engine beyond left/center/right alignment and character spacing.
acceptance: Implement justified paragraphs, logical start/end alignment, first-line indentation, and independent word spacing through documented fluent APIs.
Preserve formatting across rich-text spans, explicit line breaks, wrapping, page breaks, hyperlinks, and inherited styles.
Define interactions with RTL content, font fallback, available width, and final-line justification.
validation: Add mixed-span, multi-page, RTL, and narrow-column fixtures.
Compare geometry and visual output to agreed fixtures within declared tolerances.

work_items.title: Add text line clamping and custom ellipses
work_items.summary: Provide ClampLines-style truncation without requiring callers to pre-truncate strings or discard an entire overflowing element.
acceptance: Add a maximum-line API with a default ellipsis and caller-specified replacement text.
Compute truncation after shaping/wrapping, preserving rich-text styles and avoiding broken Unicode sequences or glyph clusters.
Specify behavior for empty text, zero/invalid limits, unavailable width, multi-page parents, links, and combined paragraph settings.
validation: Test plain/rich text, Unicode, RTL, empty input, and multiple widths.
Verify truncation neither creates extra pages nor corrupts PDF text.

work_items.title: Add OpenType controls and richer text decorations
work_items.summary: Expose font feature toggles and decoration styling that the current text-style API does not offer.
acceptance: Support enabling/disabling OpenType features using documented tags, with font fallback and cache keys reflecting the chosen features.
Add overline plus decoration color, thickness, and solid/double/dotted/dashed/wavy styles while preserving existing underline/strikethrough calls.
Keep shaping, glyph collection, font subsetting, metrics, and drawing consistent for the same style.
validation: Use licensed test fonts with known ligature/stylistic-feature behavior.
Test decorations on wrapped, mixed-size, superscript/subscript, and fallback-font spans.

work_items.title: Implement newspaper-style multi-column flow and balancing
work_items.summary: Flow a single content stream across columns and pages, including optional balancing and separator content.
acceptance: Implement a MultiColumn-style API with column count, spacing, a flowing content container, optional separator content, and height balancing.
Define layout-state snapshot/rollback rules so iterative measurement does not consume dynamic content or duplicate output.
Preserve reading order, nested layouts, page numbering, and deterministic results when content crosses columns or pages.
validation: Test uneven content, long paragraphs, tables/images, empty columns, RTL ordering, and multi-page flow.
Record generation-time and memory costs for balanced and unbalanced modes.

work_items.title: Add PreventPageBreak, Repeat and page-aware conditional rendering
work_items.summary: Extend existing ShowEntire/EnsureSpace/ShowIf behavior with the newer pagination modifiers.
acceptance: Implement PreventPageBreak semantics: attempt to move an initial block intact, then allow normal pagination when it exceeds a page.
Implement a standalone Repeat modifier and a ShowIf predicate receiving page number and total-page availability.
Document rendering-phase behavior and prevent loops, duplicate state consumption, or regressions in headers/footers and existing bool ShowIf.
validation: Test blocks shorter/longer than a page, nested pagination, page-count-dependent predicates, and repeated content.
Retain existing ShowOnce, SkipOnce, ShowEntire, and EnsureSpace tests.

work_items.title: Implement Lazy and LazyWithCache composition
work_items.summary: Defer construction of large document sections and release intermediate objects at well-defined lifecycle points.
acceptance: Expose deferred composition and an explicitly cached variant, with documented construction/reconstruction semantics.
Handle measurement passes, page replay, subsetting, dynamic components, cancellation/failures, and repeated sections safely.
Demonstrate lower retained memory on large reports and document the native-memory tradeoff of caching.
validation: Compare output of eager, lazy, and cached-lazy versions of the same fixtures.
Measure retained managed/native memory and verify cleanup on partial rendering and exceptions.

work_items.title: Complete layout helpers and inline-element alignment
work_items.summary: Fill smaller public API gaps around shrinking, stacking order, and embedded content in text.
acceptance: Add per-axis shrinking while retaining MinimalBox behavior as a supported equivalent for shrinking both axes.
Add generic ZIndex support for overlapping content, preserving the existing table-cell z-index API.
Support above/below-baseline, top, bottom, and middle alignment for injected inline elements with stable text metrics.
validation: Test nested layers, equal/different z-index values, RTL shrink alignment, and mixed-size inline elements.
Publish API mappings for equivalent existing helpers so renamed features are not counted as missing.

work_items.title: Add content-position capture and dynamic geometry access
work_items.summary: Expose supported geometry capture rather than requiring callers to inspect Skia canvas matrices manually.
acceptance: Capture an identified element's page number, position, and size for every rendered fragment/occurrence.
Make captured locations available through a documented document/dynamic-component API, with rendering-phase and unit semantics.
Handle translations, rotation/scaling, page margins, multi-page content, repeated elements, and duplicate IDs explicitly.
validation: Assert coordinates and fragment counts for nested transforms and page-spanning content.
Demonstrate a positioning/highlighting example and a tooling consumer.

work_items.title: Qualify complex-script, mixed-direction and CJK behavior
work_items.summary: Measure actual typography gaps before claiming FossPDF lacks language capabilities already partly provided by HarfBuzz.
acceptance: Build fixtures for mixed RTL/LTR runs, Arabic/Hebrew, Indic shaping, CJK breaks, emoji/surrogates, combining marks, and font fallback.
Record pass/fail evidence against defined Unicode/layout expectations and public QuestPDF behavior; identify confirmed implementation gaps.
Implement or separately track each confirmed defect, with glyph/selection/reading-order regressions covered and current RTL support preserved.
validation: Verify visual output and extracted text where meaningful; document font/platform dependencies.
Do not claim full-script parity from screenshots or a single-language sample.

work_items.title: Add first-class SVG input and preloading
work_items.summary: Bring SVG input into the library API; SVG export and an external Svg.Skia example already exist.
acceptance: Support SVG strings/files/streams or a documented equivalent, preloaded reusable SVG objects, and standard fit modes.
Integrate registered/default fonts and define handling for malformed SVG, unsupported constructs, external resource references, and ownership.
Preserve vector output where supported and document rasterization fallbacks.
validation: Test logos, paths, text/fonts, view boxes, transparency, reuse, and malformed inputs.
Run cross-platform native/parser compatibility checks with declared dependency licenses.

work_items.title: Add per-image DPI, resampling and compression quality controls
work_items.summary: Extend the existing document-wide image quality/DPI settings with image-specific optimization.
acceptance: Provide per-image quality and DPI overrides with a documented resolution/physical-size calculation and no unnecessary upscaling.
Preserve transparency and shared-image reuse while defining compressed/original image behavior.
Include effective image settings in cache keys and preserve current defaults for existing calls.
validation: Measure embedded image dimensions and output size for opaque/transparent images at several physical sizes.
Test shared images reused with different optimization settings and concurrently generated documents.

work_items.title: Add JPEG and WebP page export settings
work_items.summary: Extend GenerateImages beyond its current PNG-only encoder.
acceptance: Support PNG, JPEG, and WebP output with quality and raster-DPI settings, retaining the current overload/default behavior.
Define background/transparency behavior and format-specific validation.
Keep file, stream/byte-array workflows and page ordering consistent.
validation: Decode every output format and verify dimensions, page count, alpha/background behavior, and invalid settings.
Verify existing PNG generation remains compatible.

work_items.title: Add rounded containers, border alignment and gradients
work_items.summary: Extend solid rectangular backgrounds/borders with first-class styling APIs.
acceptance: Support uniform/per-corner radii, explicit border alignment, and linear background/border gradients.
Define clipping, layout bounds, units, content transforms, transparency, and interactions with existing border/padding APIs.
Introduce shared drawing contracts that other graphics tasks can extend safely.
validation: Add PDF/image/SVG visual fixtures at multiple sizes and DPI settings.
Verify old solid backgrounds/borders are unchanged and native resources are disposed.

work_items.title: Add advanced line styles and shadows
work_items.summary: Provide dash/gradient line APIs and configurable blurred shadows without requiring custom Canvas code.
acceptance: Support custom line dash patterns and line gradients, with explicit stroke width/units and clipping behavior.
Support shadow blur, color, offset, spread, and rounded-box interactions through a documented style object.
Document vector/raster fallback behavior and the effect of raster DPI on PDF/SVG output.
validation: Test dash scaling, gradient interpolation, transparency, clipping, nested transforms, and high-DPI shadows.
Verify determinism and native-memory cleanup for repeated drawing.

work_items.title: Add generated-document merging and page-number strategies
work_items.summary: Provide a public merge workflow for multiple IDocument instances, including original or continuous numbering.
acceptance: Implement merging generated documents while retaining each document's composition and a documented metadata/settings precedence.
Support original page numbering and continuous page numbering, including totals and section references.
Define empty inputs, repeated document instances, mixed page sizes, exceptions, and shared-resource ownership.
validation: Test merging 2-page and 3-page fixtures with both numbering strategies and correct totals.
Verify PDF/image/SVG output and .NET 9 consumer examples.

work_items.title: Implement existing-PDF loading, saving, page selection and merging
work_items.summary: Introduce a PDF processing backend and public API for working with existing files rather than only generating new documents.
acceptance: Support loading/saving existing PDFs through documented file/stream/byte-array workflows and merging selected pages from multiple sources.
Define and implement page selection, extraction, reordering, reverse/range handling, and clear invalid-range behavior.
Preserve supported page geometry, links/resources/metadata, caller-owned streams, and predictable failure cleanup.
validation: Validate page count/order, mixed sizes, malformed/truncated files, empty selections, and input/output stream ownership.
Verify native packaging and the same operation corpus on all supported OS targets.
touchpoints: New PDF operations module and public API

work_items.title: Add existing-PDF overlays and underlays
work_items.summary: Apply PDF watermarks, stationery, or background templates to selected pages of existing PDFs.
acceptance: Support overlay and underlay sources with explicit target/source page selection and repeat/placement rules.
Define behavior for page boxes, rotation, transparency, differing sizes, and layering order.
Preserve source PDFs and links/resources without accidental rasterization.
validation: Test selected/all pages, rotated/mixed-size pages, repeated templates, and transparent overlays.
Check page content/resource validity with independent PDF tools.

work_items.title: Add PDF encryption, decryption and permissions
work_items.summary: Expose password protection and permission controls matching the pinned target's supported workflows.
acceptance: Support user/owner passwords, decryption, and the target's 40/128/256-bit compatibility options with explicit strong-encryption defaults/documentation.
Implement supported permissions for printing, copying, annotations, modification, assembly, form filling, and metadata encryption.
Define password failures, unsupported security handlers, restrictions, stream handling, and PDF/A incompatibilities.
validation: Verify output with independent PDF readers/tools and wrong/right password cases.
Ensure passwords are not logged or included in exception messages or persisted test artifacts.

work_items.title: Add attachments, associated-file relationships and XMP extensions
work_items.summary: Provide the packaging and metadata primitives needed for attachments and structured invoice data.
acceptance: Embed attachments with names, MIME types, descriptions, timestamps, replacement keys, and associated-file relationships supported by the pinned target.
Add a documented XMP metadata extension workflow that preserves existing namespaces and document metadata.
Handle duplicate names, invalid files/metadata, Unicode filenames, stream ownership, and malformed input.
validation: Verify attachment bytes, PDF associated-file dictionaries, replacement behavior, and metadata round trips.
Include fixtures for Data/Source/Alternative/Supplement/Unspecified relationships.

work_items.title: Add explicit PDF compression and linearization controls
work_items.summary: Provide configurable extra PDF compression and web-optimized output rather than relying only on the renderer's defaults.
acceptance: Implement a documented extra-compression option and linearized output for generated/existing PDF workflows.
Preserve content/resources, metadata, selected conformance modes, and supported encryption/attachment combinations.
Document tradeoffs and settings precedence, including cases where file size cannot be reduced.
validation: Verify linearization flags/structure and readable output with independent tools.
Measure file size and processing overhead on text-, image-, and attachment-heavy fixtures.

work_items.title: Implement semantic structure and tagged PDF
work_items.summary: Add the logical structure needed for accessible, machine-readable PDFs.
acceptance: Define a semantic model and fluent APIs for headings, paragraphs, links, figures/alt text, lists, tables/headers, language, and ignored/decorative content.
Emit a consistent PDF structure tree with correct reading order, role mappings, page/content associations, and multi-page/repeated-element behavior.
Provide sensible automatic tags for standard layout elements and documented overrides without changing existing visual output.
validation: Inspect structure with independent PDF tools and accessibility-focused fixtures.
Test nested tables, lists, links, figures, repeated headers/footers, and mixed document languages.

work_items.title: Add selectable PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-3 conformance levels
work_items.summary: Extend the existing boolean PdfA option to the six target conformance levels with evidence-based validation.
acceptance: Support PDF/A-2a/2b/2u and PDF/A-3a/3b/3u with documented settings; map and validate the legacy PdfA boolean behavior.
Supply required metadata/output intents/font embedding/Unicode mappings and associated-file rules, with correct behavior when optimization is enabled.
Reject or clearly report incompatible combinations rather than claiming conformance from a setting alone.
validation: Validate every supported level with pinned veraPDF profiles and publish reports in CI.
Include tagged A-level, Unicode U-level, and attachment-bearing PDF/A-3 fixtures plus expected-failure cases.

work_items.title: Implement PDF/UA-1 accessibility conformance
work_items.summary: Build PDF/UA-1 support on top of semantic tagging and validate real accessibility outcomes.
acceptance: Expose PDF/UA-1 configuration and satisfy document language/title, structure, text encoding, reading order, links, figures, and table/list semantics.
Report missing author-supplied accessibility information and document author responsibilities and limitations.
Support combined archival/accessibility output where applicable without breaking either conformance mode.
validation: Run applicable automated PDF/UA validation and retain reports; include deliberate negative fixtures.
Perform documented human checks with at least one screen reader/accessibility inspection tool; automated validation alone is insufficient.

work_items.title: Add validated ZUGFeRD and Factur-X packaging workflows
work_items.summary: Demonstrate and validate embedding structured invoice XML with the required PDF/A-3 packaging and XMP metadata.
acceptance: Provide a documented packaging example/API workflow using externally supplied invoice XML, the correct attachment relationship, and required invoice metadata.
State supported ZUGFeRD/Factur-X profiles/versions and keep XML generation, invoice correctness, and packaging responsibilities explicit.
Preserve payload bytes and compatible document processing/conformance settings.
validation: Validate representative positive/negative examples with pinned Mustang tooling and veraPDF.
Confirm invoice XML can be extracted intact and the selected profile is correctly identified.

work_items.title: Add previewer element-inspection transport and source mapping
work_items.summary: Extend the existing picture/hot-reload protocol with structured element and source information.
acceptance: Define a versioned, backward-compatible inspection protocol carrying stable element IDs, hierarchy, occurrence geometry, configuration, and source locations.
Capture source file/line/member information through supported APIs with predictable behavior for reusable components and optimized/release builds.
Keep inspection optional and local, and bound payload/resource lifetime across refreshes and failed renders.
validation: Add protocol compatibility, malformed-input, refresh/disposal, and large-document tests.
Verify old preview clients continue to work or receive a clear version-compatibility response.

work_items.title: Add interactive inspection, measurement, search and source navigation
work_items.summary: Bring the existing Avalonia previewer closer to the current Companion App's development workflow.
acceptance: Add hierarchy selection, per-occurrence element details, coordinate picking, magnification, horizontal/vertical measurement, and content search.
Implement supported IDE/source navigation and richer runtime/layout diagnostics using captured source and geometry data.
Preserve pan/zoom, PDF export, hot reload, accessibility of controls, and responsive refresh/disposal behavior.
validation: Publish reproducible UI smoke-test steps and automated protocol/view-model tests where feasible.
Verify Windows/Linux/macOS behavior, large documents, repeated refreshes, and fallback behavior without IDE integration.

work_items.title: Qualify NativeAOT, trimming and runtime asset support
work_items.summary: Establish deployment parity from actual publish/run evidence rather than assuming unsupported behavior from source inspection.
acceptance: Publish and execute .NET 9 trimmed and NativeAOT consumer fixtures for text, images, SVG, fonts/subsetting, and applicable PDF operations.
Audit reflection, generated interop, resource loading, initialization, and native asset selection; fix or explicitly track reproduced gaps.
Publish an OS/architecture/runtime support matrix, including verification of Windows ARM64 where infrastructure is available, and define CI coverage.
validation: Retain publish logs and runtime smoke-test evidence for each claimed supported combination.
Keep validation-required or explicitly unsupported combinations visible; do not infer support from successful compilation alone.

work_items.title: Complete the parity audit, migration guide and release evidence
work_items.summary: Close the pinned target only after every in-scope capability has reproducible evidence and contributor-facing documentation.
acceptance: Audit every baseline row and accepted work item against QuestPDF 2026.9.1; link implementation, tests, documentation, and any approved scope decisions.
Publish a migration/API-equivalence guide, current support matrix, benchmark/conformance results, and release notes while preserving existing FossPDF workflows.
Verify clean consumers and packages on the supported runtime matrix and record the next separately versioned parity target.
validation: Require all in-scope work items complete, clean warning-as-error builds, and all test/conformance/consumer checks passing.
Reconcile missing/partial/unverified statuses and publish remaining limitations without declaring unsupported capabilities complete.
